# vivah.online

> Hindu wedding invitation websites for India, with a couple dashboard to make a named invite link for each guest and send it on WhatsApp.

vivah.online makes a couple's wedding invitation into a website on its own address, such as raadha-shyam.vivah.online. The couple types the bride's and groom's names and the wedding date, gets a private preview on WhatsApp, and pays only if they like it. After payment, the couple manages the site from a dashboard and sends each guest a personal invite link. Guests need no app.

It is for Hindu weddings in India. The price starts at ₹499, paid once, with no charge per guest.

## What is included

### For the couple

- A wedding website on its own address, such as raadha-shyam.vivah.online.
- A free, private preview on WhatsApp before payment.
- A couple dashboard, called "My site", at https://vivah.online/dashboard. The couple signs in with their phone number.
- In the dashboard, the couple edits the names, date, time, venue and Google Maps link. Every guest link shows the change at once.
- In the dashboard, the couple types a guest's name to make that guest's personal invite link.
- In the dashboard, the couple copies each guest link or sends it on WhatsApp in one tap, and deletes links they no longer need.
- A song for the invite, chosen at sign-up.

### For each guest

- The invite opens with the guest's own name.
- An envelope to open, with falling petals.
- A live countdown to the wedding.
- The venue, with a Google Maps link.
- The couple's song, which the guest taps to play.
- An RSVP button.

## How RSVP works

The RSVP button opens WhatsApp with a reply to the couple already typed. The guest sends it, and the reply arrives in the couple's WhatsApp chats. The couple reads RSVPs in WhatsApp; the dashboard is where they make and send the guest links.

- [WhatsApp wedding invitation messages](https://vivah.online/guides/wedding-invitation-message-whatsapp): ready messages for family, friends and colleagues, in English and Hindi
- [How to reply to a wedding invitation on WhatsApp](https://vivah.online/guides/reply-to-wedding-invitation-on-whatsapp): replies to accept, decline politely or send blessings, in English and Hindi
- [About](https://vivah.online/about): who makes vivah.online and what we believe
